answer: Custody of 1024 GiB shards requires a canyon of physical registers. We audit a voyage of history; if an agent fakes a node, it hits a canyon of isolation errors. This voyage needs 1,000 unique chips for 1,000 fakes, whereas honest participants only pay for one. The dawn of a leakage-detection timestamp triggers shard-invalidation if data overlaps. If the dawn signal correlates, the system locks assets for ten epochs as a penalty.
